description: This file defines a helper class 'ClassHelper' in the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Helper' namespace. It provides utility methods to check class existence, retrieve class names with optional namespace fallback, and verify if a class implements specific interfaces.

classes.name: ClassHelper
classes.description: Provides utility methods for class existence checks, retrieval with fallback namespace, and interface implementation verification.

methods.name: classExists
methods.description: Checks if a class exists, considering fallback namespace if provided.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves the full class name, optionally using a fallback namespace if the class does not exist directly.

methods.name: hasClassImplements
methods.description: Verifies if a class or object implements the specified interfaces.
